items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I played you that record when you came up to Tulane and Big Eye Louie. I don't think you quite sound like Big Eye Louie.

ctx.x: Ah, no, I don't know. That's what I'm trying to figure out now. Who do I play like? I don't really know. I just play around and rather than that's it. Uh huh.

I played you that record when you came up to Tulane and Big Eye Louie. I don't think you quite sound like Big Eye Louie. No. You got a ratty tone. I don't know what kind of tone. Yeah, well I mean it's a jazz tone. It's not a legit tone. Yeah. Oh, when you were with Buck, you showed me that picture. Well, we got a copy of that picture. Yeah. The Buck Bandit. Where was that made?

That was in, I think it was in the Coventon. It was on the 4th of July. And we had a spot job. It was on the lakefront right out there. I don't quite remember the name of the place. But before a big fight started, so the sheriffs had troops of Teague, the ass around Aunt Florida. Everybody out there was dancing with tears in our eyes. You know that when Hank... You had to quit a while. You had to quit for about an hour. Yeah. Until it all settled down. Yeah.
